virtualBindingLoss.title: Virtual Removal Probe
virtualBindingLoss.fault: Scoped trigger rejects deletion of this cleanup intent
virtualBindingLoss.agentDiscovery: Returns deleted ID and stored title despite absent virtual binding
virtualBindingLoss.restartAfterRemovingFault: Queue empty, book.removed event count remains 1
virtualBindingLoss.limitation: Synthetic virtual book has no source bytes; this tests intent acknowledgement and binding loss, not virtual-file I/O

finalUiAndPhysicalRestart.initialFault: Scoped blob metadata rejection gives committed/pending and two discoverable intents
finalUiAndPhysicalRestart.ui: Real menu, pending list, full-title/ID detail and failed retry; corrected unsupported file icon to file-text and re-inspected screenshots
finalUiAndPhysicalRestart.restoreFault: Test restore first reinserts short book, then blob metadata upsert hits the same fault. Row and 566-byte file survive; its cleanup intent is cancelled. Fixture cleanup under fault rejects honestly.
finalUiAndPhysicalRestart.firstRestartAfterFaultRemoved: Normal intent cleared, restored short book and 566-byte source preserved
finalUiAndPhysicalRestart.recordOnlyBoundary: After exact ID/title guard and isolated fixture guard, commitDomainEvents removes short without invoking file cleanup. Queue contains short and stat confirms source is still 566 bytes before process termination.
finalUiAndPhysicalRestart.nextStartup: Queue clears, source file is absent, blob storage_uri becomes null and deleted_at is set
finalUiAndPhysicalRestart.boundary: Controlled termination after a completed record commit; not power-loss testing during SQLite commit or arbitrary filesystem syscalls

pagination, input and stale projection guards
